players.product: High-cap MLCCs (CC/AC series, incl. KEMET line) for PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 corporate overview deck (company document): the company attributes Q1 net sales growth (+6.1% QoQ) to continued good momentum on A.I.-related applications as well as growth in both standard and specialty products; gross margin rose +0.8ppts QoQ from favorable product mix and cost improvement, and 'the impact of pricing increase is also beginning to flow through, helping to offset higher input cost'. Operating margin 25.2% (+0.9ppts QoQ, +4.4ppts YoY); EBITDA margin 31.7%. Q1 sales revenue US$1,206M by segment: Industrial 29.0%, Computing/Enterprise Systems 24.9%, Automotive 17.1%, Consumer 13.0%, Telecom 11.7%, Aero/Def/Med 4.3%; by channel: Distribution 44.6%, Direct OEM 35.0%, Direct EMS 20.4%; by region: APAC 49.6%, Americas 29.9%, EMEA 20.5%. Company claims: No.3 MLCC market leader in global capacity ('+15% World's Production') and No.1 polymer tantalum market leader ('+40% World's Production'); 65 manufacturing facilities (21 China, 8 Taiwan, 36 rest of world).
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 revenue US$1,206M; OPM 25.2%; EBITDA margin 31.7%; Computing/Enterprise 24.9%, Industrial 29.0%; Distribution 44.6%; APAC 49.6%
